title: The Sun in dreams
content: Has anyone seen the sun in dreams? I've had multiple experiences with the sun and all have been hostile. Once I was walking around a town with a train coming through and all of us were running for dear life trying to hop on the moving train because the sun appeared in the sky, and like an over reaching arm, a solar flare was coming down to wipe everything out. Another time I appeared before the sun itself and was smacked with a solar flare, I wasn't able to dream for quite some time after that.
